CORNELIUS, N.C., Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMOD) ("Alpha Modus" or the "Company"), an artificial intelligence technology company focused on transforming physical retail through advanced data intelligence, today announced that its wholly owned Singapore subsidiary, AMOD Tech Pte. Ltd. ("AMOD Tech"), entered into a non-binding letter of intent (the "LOI") with ChainGPT AI LLC ("ChainGPT") on November 10, 2026 to evaluate a potential acquisition of, or equity investment in, the ChainGPT business.

The LOI records preliminary discussions between AMOD Tech and ChainGPT concerning a potential purchase of some or all of the membership interests in ChainGPT AI LLC or specified assets owned by that entity. The final structure, sellers, ownership percentage and acquisition scope remain to be determined. Except for binding provisions concerning confidentiality, publicity, non-exclusivity, expenses and related legal matters, the LOI does not create a binding acquisition, sale, financing or negotiation commitment. The discussions remain non-exclusive. The LOI expires 90 days after its effective date, unless extended in writing or definitive transaction documents are executed earlier; no closing timetable has been agreed.

No purchase price or valuation has been agreed. The form and amount of consideration, any financing arrangements, and the treatment of cash, debt, working capital, CGPT tokens and other digital assets remain subject to negotiation and definitive agreements. Any proposed securities consideration would require identification of the issuer and its separate authorization and execution of the applicable definitive documents.
